edit.description: Gate.batches, and GateContext.batch with the single-span fields withheld under one
supervisorPolicy.mergeBatch and the predicate deciding whether a phase batches
the context's shape under a batch

summary: mergeBatch is a chain-overridable policy defaulting to 1, and a phase batches only when every afterMerge gate declares batches: true
acceptance: a phase whose afterMerge gates all declare batches and whose chain raises mergeBatch above 1 reports as batching; any gate not declaring it holds the phase to one span per merge; a batch context withholds entry, baseSha and landedOnSha and carries the union of touched paths
tests: the supervisor policy's mergeBatch defaults to 1
a declared supervisor mergeBatch reaches the dispatcher's policy
a phase whose afterMerge gate does not declare batches is held to one span per merge
a phase batches only when mergeBatch is above 1 and every afterMerge gate declares batches
a batch gate context withholds entry, baseSha and landedOnSha
a batch gate context's touchedPaths is the union of its spans and commitSha is the batch's last pick
notes: The surfaces and the predicate only; the merge that carries a batch is the sibling entry, which this one blocks. A gate written for one entry fails safe to serial merging — that is what the declaration buys.
